newsitem.title: CHINA: Vacuum posts net loss on poor sales.
newsitem.headline: Vacuum posts net loss on poor sales.

text.p: Shanghai Vacuum and Electron Device Co Ltd posted losses of 49.729 million yuan in 1996, down from a net profit of 121.08 million yuan in 1995, due to poor sales, the company said on Monday.

Sales of the company's key product, black-and-white television tubes, totalled 1.58 million units in 1996, down 58.99 percent compared from 1995, according to a statement in Monday's Shanghai Securities News.
The company stopped producing black-and-white televisions in 1996 after major customers failed to pay their bills in time, it said.
"The two factors dragged down sales sharply, resulting in higher stockpiles and a shortage of working capital," the statement said.
"A lack of product variety and reliance on a few major customers heightened management risks in a changeable and competitive market," it said.
